newsitem.title: USA: Martin Lawrence arrested after scuffle.
newsitem.headline: Martin Lawrence arrested after scuffle.

text.p: Comedian Martin Lawrence was arrested early Friday after a scuffle at a Hollywood nightclub, police said.
Lawrence, 31, was booked on suspicion of battery and released. Police said the incident occurred after midnight at a nightclub called "The Gate."
Officers received a telephone call from a man who said he was dancing at the club when he bumped into Lawrence and the comedian punched him in the face. Police did not identify the man.

In May, Lawrence got into a scuffle with police after he ran screaming into the street. His doctor said the star of TV's "Martin" suffered from exhaustion and dehydration. In August, he was arrested for carrying a loaded gun in a suitcase at Burbank Airport.
